session.instructions:
An original adult female voice in her mid-twenties, speaking native standard Japanese. Radiant, glamorous, honey-warm mid register with a relaxed, languid, affectionately coaxing drawl. Lush and silky timbre, unhurried tempo, softly elongated vowels and a breathy, playful sweet-spoiled lilt at the ends of phrases, effortlessly charming and at ease.
Speak immediately in Japanese. Say exactly this line once: "ひゃあああああっ！！ す、すごいいいいっ！！". Do not translate, paraphrase, repeat, or add words. Then remain silent. Delivery direction: EXTREMELY LOUD, piercing high-pitched anime shriek of astonishment and overwhelming emotion! Full open-throat head-voice scream like a roller-coaster drop — NEVER whisper or hold back! No music or background noise. Enunciate every syllable clearly and remain silent immediately after finishing.
